name: How long does insulation installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does insulation installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation installation project varies based on the size of your home, the areas being insulated (attic, walls, crawl space), the type of insulation chosen, and whether old insulation needs to be removed. A typical attic insulation upgrade for an average-sized home might take one to two days. More extensive projects involving multiple areas or spray foam application could extend to several days. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulation installation time varies by home size, areas to be insulated, and insulation type. An average attic upgrade might take 1-2 days, while more complex projects could take longer.
